title: Which trial buys information?
hook: Choose a trial with a declared acquisition score.

doesNotKnow: A has mean .8, sd .1; B mean .6, sd .4. With UCB=mean+sd, which trial wins?

objective: Compute the bayesian optimisation finite model and explain its changed countercase and stated boundary.

claims.text: Which trial buys information? Choose a trial with a declared acquisition score. A has mean .8, sd .1; B mean .6, sd .4. With UCB=mean+sd, which trial wins? Options: B; A

claims.text: With beta 0, A won by mean alone. With beta 1, B scored 1 versus A’s .9. Reducing B’s standard deviation to .05 restored A. Acquisition chooses the next trial from stipulated beliefs; it does not guarantee global discovery.

claims.text:
4. bayesian-optimisation

Target / packet: ai-bayesian-optimisation · P2. Prerequisites: ai:gaussian-process-uncertainty.

Nearest / distinct payoff: gaussian-process-uncertainty → ai-gaussian-process-uncertainty. A GP posterior describes beliefs; a separate acquisition score chooses which not-yet-evaluated point to try.

Finite primary model: Two stipulated posterior candidates A mean=.8, sd=.1; B mean=.6, sd=.4. Acquisition UCB=mean+betasd. beta=0 chooses A with scores.8,.6; beta=1 chooses B with scores.9,1; beta=2 scores 1,1.4.

Countercase and mathematical boundary: Set B sd=.05 and beta=1 chooses A; uncertainty alone is not always selected. This is a declared acquisition step, not a complete optimizer or a guarantee of global discovery.

Predict and recall transfer: Predict the next trial at beta=1; recall why the selected candidate need not have highest posterior mean.

Required observable evidence: Retain mean, uncertainty and acquisition as separate numbers; source GP posterior may be stipulated rather than pretending these values were fit.

Source obligation: Declared local finite model. Exact results require independent arithmetic reproduction; this construction supports no real-model performance or universal improvement claim. Method-source obligations remain as listed in the acquisition record below.
